nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠A medical team from the Directorate General of Health Services (#DGHS) has started health screenings at the Hili immigration checkpost in Dinajpur, #Bangladesh. 
The initiative follows instructions from the health ministry to prevent the spread of Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV).

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Led by Md Jahangir Alam from the Hakimpur Upazila Health Complex, the team is monitoring passengers for symptoms such as fever, nasal congestion, and cough. 
Travellers without masks are denied entry into the checkpost premises, and awareness campaigns are ongoing.
#hMPV #China

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠The Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (#IEDCR) confirmed a case of #HMPV in #Bangladesh involving a woman from Bhairab, Kishoreganj.
#hMPV #China #India @CDCgov #Bangladesh

nodes.text:
🟠#Bangladesh has enhanced health measures at the Hili immigration checkpost to curb #HMPV transmission. 
Travellers are being screened, and symptomatic individuals receive immediate guidance or hospital care. 
These efforts aim to mitigate further spread of the virus.
#hMPV
